scope: Incremental daily price-history system, all 2,201 items, 30-day run rate; excludes pre-existing website/order-book/email and deployment activity

assumptions.apiSecondsReason: Recent successful request latencies were 0.30–1.68 seconds; 1.2 is an estimate, not metered billable instance time. Cold starts, contention and concurrency change it.
notes: One daily invocation captures all items; no per-item cloud invocation multiplier.
Firestore-to-Cloud-Run transfer is free in the same region.
Budget admission/settlement adds database operations beyond the 3 archive reads per view.
High-traffic rows are price extrapolations, not a claim that the fixed pilot admission cap supports that traffic.
A full 365 days for all 2,201 items contains 803,365 rows; storage size varies with compression. Even a 25 MiB archive costs about $0.0037/month before free storage.

freeAllowanceExpectation: Approximately $0 incremental at personal-use volume if shared account/project free allowances remain available. Scheduler could add $0.10 if its 3 free account-wide jobs are already allocated. Existing imported data is far below the 1 GiB Firestore storage allowance.

latestReportedProjectSpend.note: Delayed month-to-date Google feed; not a final invoice or future monthly guarantee.
